dashboard.title: Transforming Nigeria: The Complete Picture
dashboard.subtitle: A comprehensive data hub showcasing progress across economic, security, agriculture, health, education and infrastructure sectors since May 2023.
dashboard.progressDesc: Comprehensive data visualization across key development sectors showing measurable progress and transformative impacts.
dashboard.progressTooltip: This dashboard aggregates data from multiple official sources including Federal Ministries, World Bank, and the National Bureau of Statistics.
dashboard.economicTransformationDesc: Nigeria's economic landscape shows positive trajectory after implementation of comprehensive reforms including fuel subsidy removal, foreign exchange market unification, and improved fiscal management.
dashboard.securityImprovementsDesc: Significant progress in addressing security challenges across all geopolitical zones through coordinated military operations, community engagement, and technology-driven surveillance.
dashboard.agriculturalRevolutionDesc: Transformative agricultural policies have boosted productivity, improved food security, and created sustainable livelihoods across Nigeria's farming communities.
dashboard.healthcareTransformationDesc: Strategic investments in healthcare infrastructure, personnel training, and medical technology have significantly improved healthcare delivery across Nigeria.
dashboard.educationTransformationDesc: Comprehensive reforms in education policy, infrastructure development, and teacher training have enhanced educational quality and accessibility across Nigeria.
dashboard.worldBankValidatedDesc: Key accomplishments recognized and validated by World Bank reports and assessments
dashboard.latestNewsDesc: Recent developments across key sectors of governance and national development
dashboard.foreignExchangeStabilityDesc: Market unification has reduced volatility by 45% since implementation
dashboard.taxRevenueIncreaseDesc: 26.4% year-over-year growth in federal tax collection
dashboard.businessEnvironmentDesc: 22% increase in new business registrations compared to 2023
dashboard.reducedIncidentsDesc: 42% reduction in security incidents nationwide compared to 2023
dashboard.communityPolicingDesc: 1,250 communities now engaged in local security partnerships
dashboard.technologyIntegrationDesc: 65% of urban centers now covered by smart surveillance systems
dashboard.cropProductionDesc: 15% increase in staple crop yields across major agricultural zones
dashboard.farmerSupportDesc: 2.3 million farmers benefiting from government input support programs
dashboard.agriculturalTechnologyDesc: 37% of registered farms now using modern agricultural technologies
dashboard.primaryHealthcareDesc: 420 new primary health centers established nationwide since 2023
dashboard.medicalPersonnelDesc: 35% increase in doctors and nurses in rural healthcare facilities
dashboard.healthInsuranceDesc: National Health Insurance now covers additional 8.5 million Nigerians
dashboard.studentLoanProgramDesc: 91,250 students benefiting from the new student loan scheme
dashboard.schoolInfrastructureDesc: 850 schools renovated or built across all states since May 2023
